body:
🌍 PETABLOCKS
Welcome to PETABLOCKS, a premier Minecraft Network built for the modern engineer. We specialize in high-performance, custom-modded environments where automation, complex machinery, and global collaboration take center stage.

🚀 Why Choose PETABLOCKS?
Elite Automation: A custom-curated modpack designed to push the limits of technical play.

Global Community: A stable, professional environment for players from all over the world.

Performance First: Dedicated resources to ensure your massive builds and complex "chunks" run smoothly.

📍 Join the Network
Ready to start engineering your legacy? Connect to our flagship modpack server today:

Server IP: play.petablocks.com

Visit our official release hub at releases.petablocks.com to download the latest version of the modpack and begin your journey.
